title: Prepare manual Space email domain onboarding with tenant-bound DNS ownership proof
detail: Draft preparation: email-specific signed one-hour TXT proof binds authenticated owner, Space and domain, verifies joined DNS strings, rejects forged/stale/mismatched state. Canonical site domain parser reused; website verifier shown separately and assigned website domain never replaces email DNS control proof. Registry no longer accepts caller provider ID: only creates provider domain internally after proof, obtains provider verification directly and returns exact provider DNS values for manual setup. Sending/receiving DNS readiness separate; apex receiving refused in favor of reply subdomain, no DNS writes or MX replacement. NOT full domain onboarding acceptance: no integrated wizard/receiving provisioning or durable provisioning operation recovery yet. Resend-success/database-failure must reconcile rather than blindly retry. SQL/RLS acceptance from EMAIL-011 remains unrun. No provider API or DNS mutation performed.

verify.evidence: Fixture tests cover tenant/owner/domain token mismatch, expiry, DNS delay/error and split TXT, provider DNS values, separate readiness/apex MX preservation; targeted lint. Keep open until integrated setup/recovery state machine, controlled owner domain verification, provider account prerequisites and SQL acceptance are proven.
